layers.name: Lock recording and lyric source
layers.deliverable: One audio hash, complete 226.8s frame clock, original lyric tokens, phrase IDs, instrumental intervals and uncertainty flags.
layers.music: Verify recording identity, coverage and source mapping. Do not infer approval from decode success.
layers.lyric: Retain exact source words; mark uncertain timings and text. Identify speech, singing and instrumentals.
layers.score: Source integrity is pass/fail; timing confidence is reported separately, not averaged into a creative score.
layers.gate: No missing audio, silent substituted opening, source mismatch or invented lyric; alignment uncertainties remain visible.
layers.status: Audio hash/coverage verified; word stress and listening approval pending.

layers.name: Map music and lyric timing
layers.deliverable: Low/mid/high energy and onset values, local beat candidates, periodicity confidence, phrase starts/ends, stressed syllable candidates, musical sections.
layers.music: 45–220, 300–2200, 2500–7000 Hz; 10ms analysis hop; percussion-weighted onset/beat estimate. Report the 80/162 BPM half/double-time ambiguity.
layers.lyric: Verify phrase and word boundaries against the recording; source timing uncertainty follows downstream. No claim that edited phrase times are phoneme-level alignment.
layers.score: Beat-map confidence and lyric-onset confidence are separate evidence scores; unverified fields remain null.
layers.gate: A timecoded listening check must validate representative beats and uncertain lyric regions before certification. Provisional mapping may feed rough-cut experiments, with uncertainty retained.
layers.status: Measured beat candidates available; listening and word-stress validation pending.

layers.name: Build the story sequence
layers.deliverable: Ordered story beats with lyric cue, intent, action, consequence and a different next setup. Preserve openness → platform control → harness → ownership.
layers.music: Assign setup/reveal/consequence to musical phrases and energy changes; preserve intentional breathing passages.
layers.lyric: The image must express the current clause and resolve its consequence before the next idea. Keep instrumental shots free of invented sung text.
layers.score: Editorial rubric: meaning 35%, cause/consequence 25%, progression 20%, musical phrase fit 20%. Each scored item requires a timecoded observation.
layers.gate: Compare the editorial plan against actual source clauses and music: >90 planned semantic fit, no reversed cause/effect or absent core story beat. Final visual clarity is verified atL4, not inferred from this plan.
layers.status: v11 failed17 planned lyric cue associations. v12now anchors76planned decisive moments to explicit source phrases or instrumental intervals; semantic quality remains unscored.

layers.name: Place and score scene cuts
layers.deliverable: Every internal cut has frame/time, nearest observed beat, band values, beat distance, musical cue, lyric cue, intent and score.
layers.music: Locked v1 metric: 70% beat proximity + 30% observed onset support. Publish every cut, baseline and 250ms offset control.
layers.lyric: Score semantic fit separately: phrase start/end or deliberately motivated emphasis, preserved word readability across the cut, correct idea on screen.
layers.score: Tempo mean >90/100, every cut >=80; every shot 2–4s. Lyric/meaning fit >90 separately. Layer score is the minimum verified dimension; missing dimensions prevent a pass.
layers.gate: Full6804-frame coverage, no gaps, distinct planned setups, no weak-cut exclusion. Actual visible changes are measured atL4. Numeric timing alone cannot unlock detail.

layers.name: Block actions and physical contacts
layers.deliverable: Hand reaches, presses, turns, contacts; objects respond; each has anticipation/contact/result timestamps. No decorative polish.
layers.music: Place meaningful contact or release on its assigned beat/onset; evaluate gesture duration against the musical phrase.
layers.lyric: Contact and consequence match the verb/object being sung. The effect cannot precede the initiating action.
layers.score: Contact timing 40%, causal order 30%, readable action 30%; >90, with no broken contact or impossible occlusion.
layers.gate: Review entry/contact/result/exit at normal speed and both neighboring cuts; failures return to blocking, not texture polish.

layers.lyric: Recheck word legibility, exact wording and sync after final compositing and compression.
layers.score: No upstream regression; all required dimensions >90, media/render integrity pass, owner creative acceptance explicit.
layers.gate: Full audio/video decode and playback; source/export parity; recoverable editable project; canonical job evidence; Hadi acceptance.

alignmentPolicy.purpose: Plan and evaluate temporal hierarchy before visual refinement. These are project-specific editorial criteria, not validated scientific measures of artistic quality.
dependencyOrder: L1 measured music and vocal map
L2 whole-song story and section/phrase assignments
L3 shot sequence and cut schedule
L4 full moving rough cut including basic physical staging and readable lyrics
L5–L7 action, lyric and world refinement
alignmentPolicy.foundationLoop: Iterate L2, L3 and L4 together: a cut that damages meaning returns to scheduling; an unreadable action returns to staging or story. Do not force an unsuitable idea onto a high-scoring beat.
alignmentPolicy.parallelPreparation: Only reversible planning may proceed with provisional upstream evidence. No downstream approval or asset polish inherits a provisional pass.
alignmentPolicy.metricSeparation: Mechanical proximity measures whether an event is near a detected cue. Editorial review decides whether that cue and visible event belong together. Never average these into a single flattering score.
alignmentPolicy.scoring: For each applicable criterion: rating 0–4 / 4 × predeclared weight. Music, lyric and visible-execution scores are recorded separately. No applicable evidence means null. Instrumentals use explicit non-applicable lyric status and source justification, never an automatic 100.
alignmentPolicy.aggregation: Report every item, mean, minimum, count below threshold and evidence coverage. A level passes only with complete evidence, each dimension mean >90, no reviewed item <80, and no hard failure. Scene cuts additionally retain the existing >90 mean / >=80 every-cut music gate. Overall foundation score is the lowest complete dimension; any null or hard failure prevents passage.
alignmentPolicy.reviewIndependence: Freeze criteria before revision comparison. Preserve failed observations. Do not retune weights or time tolerances to make the current version pass.
hardFailures: No meaningful visible scene change within the required 2–4s cadence
Wrong or missing core lyric idea
Changed or missing original lyric words
Effect before cause or unreadable decisive action
Broken physical contact, impossible scale or misleading occlusion
Unresolved user rejection of the reviewed dimension
alignmentPolicy.holds: Not every beat demands a cut, and not every word demands motion. Assign an event type and cue before scoring. A motivated hold is judged against its phrase duration and readability, not penalized for lacking animation. Holds cannot excuse missing required scene changes.
alignmentPolicy.tolerance: Keep the existing cut tolerance of 150ms. New action/vocal tolerances must be set before evaluation using source confidence and event type, logged with configuration revision; uncertain ASR timings cannot certify syllable precision.

alignmentLevels.purpose: Emotional and causal progression across musical sections
alignmentLevels.musicRubric: Energy arc 40; section arrival 35; contrast and breathing 25
alignmentLevels.lyricRubric: Core meaning 40; cause and consequence 35; ownership resolution 25
alignmentLevels.visibleExecution: All chapters present; coherent progression; no section reduced to repeated labels
alignmentLevels.evidence: Full-song timed story map and uninterrupted rough-cut review

alignmentLevels.purpose: One setup, action and consequence for each source idea
alignmentLevels.lyricRubric: Current clause meaning 50; verb/object relationship 30; consequence 20
alignmentLevels.visibleExecution: Viewer can identify what changed and why before the next idea
alignmentLevels.evidence: Phrase ID, source interval, visual intention and entry/action/result/exit evidence

alignmentLevels.purpose: A genuinely different view or situation every 2–4s
alignmentLevels.musicRubric: Existing cut metric: observed beat proximity 70; onset support 30; separate perceptual review
alignmentLevels.lyricRubric: Clause continuity 40; motivated cut 40; reading continuity 20
alignmentLevels.visibleExecution: Different composition/action information; continuous space and causal order
alignmentLevels.evidence: Every cut frame, band values, nearest observed beat, adjacent shots and actual visible change

alignmentLevels.purpose: Physical event lands on the selected musical and semantic cue
alignmentLevels.musicRubric: Chosen accent contact 50; preparation duration 25; consequence/release 25
alignmentLevels.lyricRubric: Correct verb 40; correct object 30; cause/result order 30
alignmentLevels.visibleExecution: Reach, contact and response visible; proportions and occlusion credible
alignmentLevels.evidence: Anticipation/contact/result frames, assigned cue, timing error, frame and motion observations

alignmentLevels.purpose: Words remain readable while selected accents support the vocal
alignmentLevels.musicRubric: Verified vocal onset 50; selected stress fit 30; hold/release 20
alignmentLevels.lyricRubric: Exact words/order 40; phrase comprehension 40; meaningful emphasis 20
alignmentLevels.visibleExecution: Readable at phone and laptop sizes through cuts; no distracting word motion
alignmentLevels.evidence: Original tokens, phrase/stress confidence, onset error, reading hold and size-specific playback

alignmentLevels.purpose: Support an already accepted action and energy curve
alignmentLevels.lyricRubric: Focus on current meaning 60; absence of semantic distraction 40
alignmentLevels.visibleExecution: Consistent materials/light; subordinate movement does not compete with action or words
alignmentLevels.evidence: Only after full foundation passes; compare against accepted rough cut for regressions
